model_annotation: The chart is a horizontal bar chart illustrating the number of participants associated with several labeled criteria. The category axis is vertical on the left and lists the criteria in the following top-to-bottom order: “Relevant FCs,” “FC Summary,” “Relevance Explanation,” “Clarity and Simplicity,” “Overall Summary,” “Filters,” and “Veracity Explanation.” The value axis is horizontal at the bottom and is labeled “Number of Participants,” shown on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0, 2, 4, and 6. Each criterion is represented by a single horizontal bar with a distinct color shade and a numeric value printed at the right end of the bar: “Relevant FCs” (dark purple) reaches 6, “FC Summary” (dark blue) reaches 5, “Relevance Explanation” (blue-green) reaches 3, “Clarity and Simplicity” (teal) reaches 3, “Overall Summary” (green) reaches 2, “Filters” (light green) reaches 1, and “Veracity Explanation” (yellow-green) reaches 1. The bars appear ordered from highest to lowest value from top to bottom, and there are no additional groupings, stacks, legends, or special visual emphasis beyond the end-of-bar value labels.
